name: stratosnotes-arbitrum
description: Structured notes as BPMN workflows on Arbitrum Sepolia (collateral vault on Robinhood Chain testnet), observed and paid by Chainlink CRE

scripts.test: npm -w packages/core run test && npm -w packages/sdk run test && npm -w services/indexer run test && npm -w services/notifier run test && npm -w services/api run test && npm -w services/edge run test && npm -w app run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/core run typecheck && npm -w packages/sdk run typecheck && npm -w services/keeper-fallback run typecheck && npm -w services/indexer run typecheck && npm -w services/notifier run typecheck && npm -w services/api run typecheck && npm -w services/edge run typecheck && npm -w app run typecheck && (cd cre/notes-keeper-evm && npx tsc --noEmit)
scripts.build:web: npm run proof && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.deploy: npm run proof && npm --prefix web run deploy
